title: ‘Moana’ Failing to Make Box Office Splash With $45M Opening
summary: Disney's live-action reimagining of its 2016 animated feature faces a stormy path and comes less than two years after the massive launch for 'Moana 2.'
contentText: Facing a stormy path, Disney's live-action take on its 2016 animated feature collected nearly the same opening sum as 2025's 'Snow White' and comes less than two years after the massive launch for 'Moana 2.'
